summary: Recents are written to the database but never displayed or otherwise surfaced, leaving the named requirement '...recents usable in UI' unmet at the source level, independent of the pending physical-device gate.
claim: Recents are written to the database but never displayed or otherwise surfaced, leaving the named requirement '...recents usable in UI' unmet at the source level, independent of the pending physical-device gate.

evidence.source: MainViewModel.select() (MainViewModel.kt) calls `store.user.user().recent(Recent(...))` on every selection, but `UserDao.recents()` (data/Databases.kt) is never invoked or collected anywhere in MainViewModel.kt or MainActivity.kt, and there is no 'Recent' UI section/tab in the Compose tree.

suggested_remediation: Add a Recents UI surface backed by `UserDao.recents()`.
suggested_validation: Select several catalog/custom entries, open the Recents UI, and confirm they appear ordered by recency.
